name: search-meter
description: Track shell, web and tool searches with counters for immediate hits, hits following empty results and misses. The colors use output-based heuristics to help you inspect search activity.
sourceDescription: Counts the model's searches and colors each one: green found first try, yellow found after misses, red found nothing
author: Mehmet Aras

category.label: Testing Mods
category.basis: Diagnoses search outcomes and retries across shell, web and tool searches; it does not browse project files.
